storage: Keep in a cool, dark place, away from the stove; close the cap tightly. Do not reuse oil that smells rancid or is dark and smoky.
looksLike: A clear, pale-yellow, neutral-smelling liquid, sold in 1 L pouches, bottles and tins.
howToPick: Sealed pouch or bottle, within date, clear oil with no sediment or smell. Check the label says refined sunflower oil, not a blend, if you want pure sunflower.
shelfLife: Usually about 9 to 12 months sealed (check the pack; general guidance).

usedIn.raw: 12 g per serving (about 1 tbsp, a scant; sunflower oil or any neutral oil)
